Subject: [opensuse]  Re: NFS, openSUSE 10.0 and 10.3

On Fri, 15 Feb 2008 16:06:35 +0100, Roger Oberholtzer wrote:

[...]
> No complaints. However, on the 10.3 client, I get:
> 
> 	# mount -t nfs 10.1.6.131:/home /tmp/qqq
> 
> 	mount: 10.1.6.131:/home failed, reason given by server: Permission
> denied
> 
> This happens for all 10.3 systems I have. So if I am doing something
> wrong, I am at least consistent.
> 
> Anyone else have this problem? Any pointer as to how I can get more
> information about the problem? The server does not say more.

Yes, I had this problem.  The problem is that the client side doesn't 
automatically run start-statd as I believe it used to.

If you run this (as root), then the mounts will work fine.

There are a couple of open bugs on this in bugzilla.  One of them is 
353538.

Jim
